guard: a tmux seat that outlives its manager's crash is adopted by the successor, keeps its pane process and serves the turn the dead manager accepted, while a seat whose pane exited is retired
why: Live: real broker, real Manager in a child process SIGKILLed mid-turn, a private tmux server and a stub seat that joins presence.
Manager source is imported directly by the host through tsx; the tmux runtime is imported from its dist, so the command builds it and the tmux mutation rebuilds it after restore.

mutations.name: the successor retires a surviving tmux seat instead of adopting it
mutations.find: record.supervise ? await this.restartSupervisedSeat(row, record) : await this.adoptSeat(row, record);
mutations.expectRed: the successor adopts the surviving seat
mutations.cell: the successor adopts the surviving seat

mutations.name: an unsupervised tmux seat writes no record
mutations.find: const adoptable = a.handle.reference !== undefined && typeof this.requiredRuntime.adopt === "function";
mutations.expectRed: the first manager spawns two tmux seats and records both
mutations.cell: the first manager spawns two tmux seats and records both

mutations.name: the tmux runtime adopts a pane whose process has exited
mutations.find:
if (tmux.paneState(paneId) !== "running") throw new Error(`tmux runtime: pane ${paneId} has exited`);
    return this.handle(windowId, windowId, paneId, serverPid);
mutations.expectRed: a seat whose process died while no manager ran is retired, not adopted
mutations.cell: a seat whose process died while no manager ran is retired, not adopted
